info.title: AGC Cheswerta CMS API
info.description:
Church management system API — members, givings, attendance, fellowship scheduling, council roster, SMS broadcast, and admin tools.

**Getting started:** call `POST /api/auth/login`, copy the `token` from the response, then click **Authorize** above and paste it in as `<token>` (no need to type "Bearer " — Swagger adds that automatically). Every other request will then include it.

**Not included:** a few blueprints registered in the app (announcements, modules, feature flags, generic settings, audit log, account locks, login attempts, file uploads, generic db query, stats/PDF reports, SMS logs, church info) aren't documented here yet — ask to have them added and share those route files.

**Server selector:** the dropdown at the top switches between Local and Production — edit the Production URL in the spec to match your real domain.
